name: veterinaria-app
description: Aplicación web de Clínica Veterinaria - Node + Express + React + Vite + Tailwind

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../api && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.render:build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.render:start: set NODE_ENV=production&& cd server && node index.js
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
